formalizedScope: For actual ramified dyadic finite number-field completions, the corrected even n >= 2 v6 Lemma 8.3 local conclusion is proved for the specified literal integral tensor scalar extension, provided a lower good BONG is supplied on the specified lower lattice. The upper good BONG lives on that exact lattice; signed-prefix and adjacent defect bounds follow from the concrete completion map. General existence of a lower good BONG for every lattice in the source claim is not yet connected. Author clarification makes integral isometry class, not literal ambient equality, the comparison target; report 51

For arbitrary matching dyadic BONG basis lattices, an integral scalar-extension isometry maps each pure tensor of a lower BONG vector to the corresponding upper vector. This is optional stronger vector-level evidence, not an additional prerequisite for the author-confirmed class-level local conclusion; report 50

At actual dyadic finite number-field completions in the corrected even n >= 2 classic-universal scope with a supplied lower good BONG, the literal tensor scalar-extension lattice itself has a transported good BONG with exactly the mapped lower coefficient values; report 49. The conditional ramified obstruction was subsequently proved in report 51

The actual finite-completion mapped-value diagonal realization is isometric to the literal tensor scalar extension without separate lower basis-equality or upper order-monotonicity premises; report 48. The local obstruction was subsequently closed in report 51
Classic integrality and classic n-universality
Theorem 1.1 proved equivalence for every source rank and n >= 2, with both parity branches
Classic maximality and existence of classic-maximal over-lattices
Abstract classic-maximal testing reduction
Local BONG proof chain in Sections 2-6, with source differences recorded separately
Theorem 1.5 local implication for every n >= 1 and Corollary 6.3 even branch
Author-corrected v6 (inherited from v5) Lemma 7.1, Corollary 7.2 bridge, and Section 7 ambient exhaustion
Lemma 7.4 testing equivalence in both even and odd rank
Lemma 7.7 and all three clauses of Lemma 7.10 on the literal published even table
Theorem 1.3(i)-(iii), including even and odd literal deletion minimality
Lemma 7.11 row-by-row deletion witnesses for every literal odd-table index and the combined odd minimality endpoint
Every literal even and odd published table row is classic-maximal, via explicit volume order zero or one and the generic volume-index criterion; report 19
Kernel-checked refutation of the obsolete broader publisher Lemma 7.1(ii) disjunction when e > 1, retained as a regression result
Kernel-checked e=2, n=3 counterexample to the obsolete unrestricted odd clause of v5 Corollary 6.3, including nonisometry to the diagonal lattice with the same coefficients
Unconditional v6 odd testing sufficiency obtained by representing the complete even table one rank lower
O'Meara 63:5 and 63:9, including all three Proposition 2.8(ii) numerical formulas, are internally proved from the principal-unit filtration and finite representative equivalences; report 21

The revised v6 Lemma 8.3 upper-order monotonicity and concrete local ramified contradiction are proved at actual finite completions with an explicit lower good BONG; literal common-ambient equality of a separately realized upper lattice is not required under the author's integral-isometry-class interpretation; report 51

For the literal scalar extension of a specified dyadic lattice, the carrier is the upper valuation-ring span of pure tensors. At actual finite completions, the embedding preserves the valuation ring and carries integral bases to base-changed integral bases; the actual upper good BONG is transported onto this literal lattice; reports 45 and 49

Mapped-value BONG basis-lattice isometry follows from full Gram equality and valuation-ring preservation. The author-corrected even classic-universal case discharges the lower basis and upper monotonicity premises at actual finite completions; reports 46-48

At actual dyadic finite completions, the completion embedding specializes the mapped-value isometry to the literal tensor scalar extension and a standard upper diagonal realization; report 47. The later reports 48-51 discharge its basis, monotonicity, and ramified-obstruction obligations once a lower good BONG is supplied

Lemma 8.1(i)-(iii) is proved at actual dyadic finite completions in its stated coefficient and existential-lattice scopes. In the corrected even n >= 2 classic-universal scope with a supplied lower good BONG, the literal integral scalar extension has an upper good BONG with mapped exact values and the ramified local non-universality conclusion of v6 Lemma 8.3 is proved without assuming its conclusion; reports 45-51. General lower good-BONG existence, Proposition 8.2 and global Theorems 1.5, 1.7-1.9 still depend on explicitly identified but not fully instantiated existence, number-field localization, globalization, local universality, and strong-approximation laws; no odd Lemma 8.3 endpoint is asserted
excludedScope: General lower good-BONG existence for every lattice in the unqualified v6 Lemma 8.3 statement. Concrete number-field instances for the global lattice system, localization, positive-definite globalization at a selected finite place, representation transport across local equivalence, construction of the place equivalence with the standard height-one spectrum, non-dyadic and dyadic sum-of-squares local universality, and strong approximation in Section 8. The local even obstruction with an explicit lower good BONG is proved in report 51
The obsolete broader Lemma 7.1(ii) from the publisher and arXiv comparison copies

The obsolete v5 unrestricted odd Corollary 6.3 is refuted at e=2 and n=3; v6 explicitly excludes it. No v6 odd endpoint is asserted for Lemma 8.3 or Theorems 1.7-1.8. The local even n >= 2 Lemma 8.3 endpoint is concrete with a lower good-BONG premise; general existence and global Section 8 endpoints remain open
reviewNotice: The semantic basis is the frozen author-approved v6 TeX manuscript, excluded from Git and Review Kits. Reports 44-51 document the source delta, literal scalar extension, mapped-value isometry, and a concrete ramified local even obstruction with an explicit lower good BONG. General existence of that BONG for every source-scope lattice is not yet connected, so the unqualified Lemma 8.3 is not declared complete. The author confirmed that upper x_i denote canonical images 1 tensor x_i and that lattice comparison is by integral isometry class, not literal equality of ambient subsets. The old v5 odd Corollary 6.3 is refuted and excluded by v6. Global Section 8 endpoints still lack concrete arithmetic and approximation instances and independent human semantic review. The project grade remains recorded as D pending comprehensive reassessment; this checkpoint is not a clean merged-commit Review Kit or release receipt.
